title: 28,693,500) shares that they acquired through the reviews of comparative remuneration offered by other
columns:
Directors’ Remuneration
Remuneration of managing director
The remuneration package and long-term incentives
for the Managing Director are determined on the same
basis and using the same qualifying criteria as for other
employees.
The remuneration of the managing director is subject to
an annual performance review process conducted by the
board.
